options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: ba_policy_categories
options.description: The threat categories to which the rule applies

options.name: ba_rule_action
options.description: The action configured for the rule that must take place if the traffic matches the rule criteria

options.name: by_threat_score
options.description: Minimum threat score can be set between 40 to 70

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: departments
options.description: The departments to which the Sandbox Rule applies

options.name: description
options.description: Additional information about the rule

options.name: enabled
options.description: Determines whether the Sandbox Rule is enabled or disabled

options.name: file_types
options.description: The threat categories to which the rule applies

options.name: first_time_enable
options.description: Indicates whether a First-Time Action is specifically configured for the rule. The First-Time Action takes place when users download unknown files. The action to be applied is specified using the firstTimeOperation field.

options.name: first_time_operation
options.description: The action that must take place when users download unknown files for the first time

options.name: groups
options.description: The groups to which the Sandbox Rule applies

options.name: id
options.description: Unique identifier for the Sandbox Rule

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels that are applicable to the rule.

options.name: location_groups
options.description: The location groups to which the Sandbox Rule applies

options.name: locations
options.description: The locations to which the Sandbox Rule applies

options.name: ml_action_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether to enable or disable the AI Instant Verdict option To have the Zscaler service use AI analysis to instantly assign threat scores to unknown files. This option is available to use only with specific rule actions such as Quarantine and Allow and Scan for First-Time Action.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Sandbox Rule

options.name: order
options.description: Rule order number of the Sandbox Rule

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: protocols
options.description: The protocols to which the rule applies

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: rank
options.description: Admin rank of the Sandbox Rule

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: url_categories
options.description: The URL categories to which the rule applies Use the info resource zia_url_categories_info to retrieve the category names.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: users
options.description: The users to which the Sandbox Rule applies

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.

options.name: zpa_app_segments
options.description: The list of ZPA Application Segments for which this rule is applicable. This field is applicable only for the ZPA forwarding method.
